scope: Approved local TaCZ native experimental attachment policy; not a claim of exact PUBG physical interchangeability.

rules.capacity: Preserve each original extended_mag_ammo_amount and original base ammo_amount byte-for-byte; no universal capacities or sorting.
rules.initial: Remove only these nine resolved attachment IDs and their experimental marker; preserve every original attachment leaf.
rules.experimental: Add reviewed families only where the original slot and native level1/2/3 capacities remain valid; no slot creation.
rules.unknownGuns: No new magazine authorization until reviewed; other original attachment leaves remain intact.
rules.dmrSlotRule: Both rifle and sniper families may be allowed, but they share one EXTENDED_MAG slot and native capacity level.
